sentence: This project uses geochemical tracers to find out how long fossil groundwater has stayed in the subsurface of an aquifer.
This project studies how viruses that live in bacterial genomes as prophages affect the gut microbes of a tunicate and a zebrafish.
This project tries to find out where the mineral monazite carried by rivers comes from by dating it and measuring its rare earth elements.
This project studies how chemical defects in the crystal structures of ferroelectric polymers change their polarization and electrocaloric behavior.
This project studies the physical principles that rearrange DNA in the cell nucleus as stem cells become specialized cells.
This project gets a tool called a nanoindenter that measures the mechanical properties of materials at the nanoscale under different conditions.
This project studies how the spread of oyster larvae between locations keeps oyster populations going as conditions change over time.
This project builds materials and cells that let electronics and microbes pass signals to each other through redox reactions.
This project builds and tests modules that work as submerged barriers and uses sensors to measure how they change waves.
This project builds learning methods that let many autonomous agents make reliable decisions using only local information.
This project builds statistical tools for studying collections of networks that share common features, such as brain networks of different individuals.
This project builds photonic integrated circuits on a semiconductor of antimony and gallium that work with infrared light and can sense chemicals.
This project builds a program that teaches how artificial intelligence is used in defensive and offensive cyber operations.
This project works with colleges and employers to define the skills needed for mechatronics, which combines mechanical systems, electronics, robotics, and automation.
This project builds ways to detect and stop attacks that steal machine learning models used in devices for scientific studies.
